Wellbeing, treated as a latent construct, is operationalised through indicators of human capital (health status and educational attainment) and material resources (income). The results demonstrate a robust and statistically significant relationship between wellbeing and the time\u2011allocation decisions made by individuals and their partners. The analysis also reveals gendered patterns in this relationship, alongside differences between weekends and working days.
